entries.summary: Bearish elevated downside risk unchanged for November 17–19. Reuters November 17 reported Nasdaq-100 futures -0.34% at 10:51 UTC, while a later secondary QQQ premarket quote was +0.65% at 06:44 ET; quotes are not synchronized. Monday QQQ -2.67%, SPY -1.91%, SOX near -5.3% remain strongest US evidence. Reuters reports Nvidia options implying an 8.5% move either direction after earnings, not a directional forecast. Brent $92.76 and WTI $86.11 were reported without exact tick times. Secondary Treasury yields 10Y 5.11%, 2Y 4.80% imply +31bp. Open Watch increased to 166 events as of 10:22 UTC; no verified path-changing new event.
bullish: A sustained US cash-market QQQ and SOX rebound with improved breadth could invalidate the bearish trend; not yet observed.
A positive Nvidia guidance surprise and easing volatility or yields could produce a sharp relief rally; results not yet released.
Oil below earlier November levels could alleviate inflation pressure, but direct equity response is unverified.
bearish: November 16 synchronized QQQ -2.67% vs SPY -1.91% and Reuters-reported SOX about -5.3% indicate chip-led relative weakness.
Reuters 10:51 UTC November 17 reports Nasdaq-100 and S&P futures both -0.34%, versus earlier nonsynchronized +0.5% Nasdaq futures indication.
Elevated Treasury yields and new AI-chip export restrictions increase valuation and semiconductor demand risks; impact not yet quantified.

editorial.marketOverview: Bearish elevated downside risk persists for Nasdaq/QQQ over November 17–19, anchored by Monday's QQQ and SOX weakness. Tuesday premarket evidence is mixed and not synchronized.
editorial.whatChanged: Open Watch increased from 165 to 166 records. Reuters reports Nvidia options imply 8.5% two-sided earnings movement, increasing clarity about event risk without changing directional outlook. A later secondary QQQ premarket gain contrasts with earlier Reuters futures weakness, without synchronized confirmation. Brent and WTI reports updated.
editorial.marketInterpretation: Semiconductor weakness is observed, while specific causal attribution to export controls, leadership changes and rates remains uncertain. The implied options move is two-sided. Secondary 10Y 5.11% minus 2Y 4.80% gives +31 basis points.
editorial.threeDayPath: Tuesday retail sales 08:30 ET, industrial production 09:15 ET and Nvidia after-close earnings are immediate tests. Wednesday FOMC minutes and Thursday follow-through will determine continuation versus stabilization; no unreleased results are assumed.
editorial.bullCase: A sustained QQQ/SOX cash-market rebound, stronger breadth, easing yields and volatility, and positive Nvidia guidance could invalidate the bearish case.
editorial.bearCase: Further semiconductor underperformance, weak Nvidia guidance, elevated yields and volatility, or export-control pressure could extend the selloff; options imply a large move in either direction.
editorial.watchNext: Verify macro release outcomes and actual equity responses, synchronized SOX/QQQ, breadth, VXN/VIX, official Treasury yields and CME FedWatch. Review the new Open Watch event and Nvidia earnings, then FOMC minutes.
